identity_reason: it is the LineChart line without axes, in the muted tone with the first data slot for its last point
concept: A small line with no axes for a Stat or a table cell, its trend said in words as an image.

root.why: the line fills the width it is given with a small minimum

svg.why: the drawing may reach past its box so the end dot is never clipped

line.why: the line is drawn in the de-emphasis tone so it supports the number beside it

last.why: the current point is a dot in the first data slot with a surface ring

@media forced-colors: active.why: in forced colours the system draws the edges and marks so every part stays findable
